annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3201-16 Standard Practice for Ensuring Dependability of Software Used in Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS)
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3201-16 Standard Practice for Ensuring Dependability of Software Used in Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS)
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.09
annotation.summary_en: ASTM store page for F3201-16, a voluntary standard practice for ensuring the dependability (safety and security) of software in unmanned aircraft systems, aimed at small UAS and as a possible alternate means of compliance for civil aviation authorities. Includes scope text and shipping fees.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aims to ensure dependability (safety and security) of UAS software
Covers organizational controls, software architecture, metrics and design analysis, code review, and testing
Intended to support small UAS operations as an alternate means of compliance
Application to other UAS operations at the discretion of the civil aviation authority
User responsible for determining regulatory applicability
